original.headline: 80th Independence Day updates: World leaders extend greetings to India; Opposition slams PM Modi's 'dimagi Naxal' jibe
original.raw_text:
PM Modi calls for manufacturing sector boost, lays out seven-point reform framework Updated - August 15, 2026 11:28 pm IST
A young child sprints through Mumbai with the Tricolour held high, radiating joy during the Independence Day celebrations on August 15, 2026.
                                                  | Photo Credit:  
                          Emmanual Yogini
Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s Independence Day address from the ramparts of the Red Fort on Saturday (August 15, 2026) was replete with a seven-point reform plan called “Saptadhara” and an outreach to the youth through AI skilling and free online coaching, in an attempt to answer anxieties related to the post-globalisation economy.
In his 13th address to the nation — the first in 80 years that saw Vande Mataram preceding the national anthem — the Prime Minister directly spoke to some of the challenges facing India’s economy, security and domestic anxieties with regard to the youth, employment, and the advent of Artificial Intelligence (AI).
Kerala Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan , during the Independence Day celebrations at Central Stadium in Thiruvananthapuram on Saturday (August 15, 2026), called upon people to become “guardians and fighters of a strong democracy founded on open-mindedness, tolerance, debate, self-correction and innovation.” Remembering the flood victims, Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma on Saturday (August 15, 2026) said the State government was preparing a comprehensive rehabilitation plan for the flood-affected families .
This Independence Day, perhaps the most important reminder for us as citizens is that democracy is rebuilt and sustained through dialogue and interaction. When people across socio-economic and political backgrounds connect, share grief and laughter, make friends, chat and get to know one another, they begin to build something more fundamental: trust.
Explore how protests, community kitchens, and shared experiences are fostering trust and connections among diverse groups in India.
India’s global partners, including France, Russia and Australia, on Saturday (August 15, 2026) extended greetings to the country on its 80 th Independence Day, reaffirming their commitment to strengthening bilateral ties and regional cooperation.
World leaders, including Macron and Putin, extend heartfelt greetings to India on its 80th Independence Day, celebrating strong ties.
“Red Fort is not a place from where one should speak lies,” Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav on Saturday (August 15, 2026) hit out at Prime Minister Narendra Modi over his pitch for women’s reservation bill in his Independence Day speech saying the legislation was already passed in 2023 and the government should implement it in the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections.
Mr. Yadav also claimed that Partition is a cause for celebration for the BJP.
In his speech from the ramparts of the Red Fort, Modi urged political parties to rise above differences to help secure 33 per cent reservation for women in legislatures.
Speaking to reporters at the Samajwadi Party office here, Yadav said, “One should not speak lies from the Red Fort. It is not the place from where lies should be spoken.”
On the occasion of the 80th Independence Day, 41 police officers and personnel were honoured for outstanding services, officials said.
According to the police, 41 police officers and personnel of Gurugram Police were presented commendations and honours for their outstanding, commendable and dedicated services. The honoured police personnel have made notable contributions in maintaining law and order and controlling crime.
Among the honoured police personnel, ASI Rajendra was specially honoured for making the supreme sacrifice in the line of duty.
Odisha Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi on Saturday (August 15, 2026) advised youths to focus on their career, instead of being influenced by “external forces” that do not want to see India as a strong nation, while asserting that only Prime Minister Narendra Modi can solve their problems.
Addressing a State-level event here marking the 80th Independence Day, the Chief Minister made five major announcements, including removing the maximum limit of six chances for the State civil service exam. Aspirants can now appear in the exam till they reach the upper age limit.
He also announced compassionate recruitment following the death of government employees, creating three lakh employment opportunities in the next two to three years, which will be extended to 20 lakh in the next five years.
BJP MP Anurag Thakur on Saturday accused the Congress leadership of showing “deep discomfort” with the full rendition of Vande Mataram at the party headquarters on Independence Day and demanded that the Congress apologise to the nation, alleging that its leaders insulted the National Song.
“Today, the Congress leadership has once again demonstrated its deep discomfort with the full rendition of ‘Vande Mataram’. This is not merely a matter of protocol; it is a question of the nation’s honour,” Mr. Thakur said.
“Driven by petty politics and a policy of appeasement, the Congress has insulted the National Song today. The Congress must apologise to the entire nation,” he added.
Mr. Thakur claimed that while the original version of ‘Vande Mataram’, which he alleged was earlier “discarded or removed” by former Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru, was being sung, Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge, Sonia Gandhi and Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi appeared uncomfortable.
Ladakh Lieutenant Governor V K Saxena on Saturday joined the people of the Union territory in celebrating the 80th Independence Day by hoisting the national flag at the polo ground here and taking the salute of the marching contingents.
Addressing the gathering, Saxena paid tribute to the freedom fighters whose courage and sacrifice secured the country’s Independence and laid the foundation for its democratic journey, an official statement said.
He also saluted the armed forces, paramilitary personnel, Ladakh Scouts, police and Border Roads Organisation (BRO) staff performing their duties amid the challenging terrain and harsh climate of Ladakh.
Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah on Saturday (August 15, 2026) extended greetings and best wishes to his Indian counterpart Narendra Modi and the people of India on the occasion of the country’s 80th Independence Day.
Mr. Shah’s message comes amid Nepal’s efforts to strengthen ties with India, with the Himalayan nation seeking greater economic cooperation and connectivity with its immediate neighbour.
“On the occasion of India’s 80th Independence Day, I extend my heartfelt greetings and best wishes to PM @narendramodi and the friendly people and Government of India,” Shah’s office said in a post on X.
‘Suryapath Tiranga’ -- a first-of-its-kind initiative, involving several Indian missions, from east to west, under which the images of the tricolour is being “digitally relayed” across multiple time zones, began from India’s High Commission in Fiji on Saturday (August 15, 2026) to mark the country’s 80th Independence Day.
The campaign symbolically traces the journey of the rising sun across time zones, carrying the spirit of India’s freedom, unity and national pride across continents, officials said.
“With the first rays of the sun, the Indian flag was raised first in Suva, Fiji, marking the beginning of the global Tiranga relay, ‘Surya Path Tiranga’ - a symbolic journey carrying the spirit of India’s Independence Day across the world,” the High Commission of India in Fiji posted on X.
Sikkim Governor Om Prakash Mathur on Saturday (August 15, 2026) inaugurated the first organ transplantation centre and post-transplant ICU at STNM Hospital here.
Two Sikkimese patients underwent kidney transplants for the first time within the State.
The Governor inaugurated the facilities in the presence of Chief Minister Prem Singh Tamang and Health Minister GT Dhungel.
Speaking to reporters after the inauguration, Mr. Tamang called the commencement of kidney transplantation in Sikkim a “historic milestone”, saying it had been achieved on the state’s 80th Independence Day.
Gujarat Deputy Chief Minister Harsh Sanghavi on Saturday (August 15, 2026) called for planning to achieve the ambitious goal of ‘Viksit Bharat’ by 2047, saying only two decades were left to meet the target.
He was addressing a gathering after hoisting the national flag at the Manjalpur Sports Complex in Vadodara as part of the district-level Independence Day celebration.
“Only 20 years remain until India completes 100 years of independence. Prime Minister Narendra Modi set the goal of Viksit Bharat at 2047 five years ago. There are now only two decades to achieve this ambitious goal. Therefore, the 80th Independence Day is not merely a celebration; it is a great source of inspiration for planning the next 20 years,” he said.
Chief Minister of Telangana, Revanth Reddy, inaugurated the statues of former Prime Ministers Jawahar Lal Nehru and Rajiv Gandhi at Sangareddy District, Telangana. Photo: Mohd Arif WhatsApp Image 2026-08-15 at 4.42.12 PM.jpeg
WhatsApp Image 2026-08-15 at 4.42.12 PM.jpeg
The Chief Justice of India, Surya Kant, in his Independence Day address at the Supreme Court on Saturday (August 15, 2026), said the younger generation’s “remarkable resilience”, awareness of social realities, and their use of technology to communicate and access knowledge give the nation every reason to be confident in them. The Bar and Bench walk with you: CJI to youth in I-Day message, a day after Bar Council overreach CJI Surya Kant praises youth's resilience and tech-savviness in Independence Day address, emphasizing their role in shaping justice.
CJI Surya Kant praises youth's resilience and tech-savviness in Independence Day address, emphasizing their role in shaping justice.
Terming federalism as “strength of the country”, J&K Chief Minister Omar Abdullah, said on the 80th Independence Day on Saturday (August 15, 2026) in Srinagar, that J&K should be returned “whatever was taken away from it”, in an oblique reference to the special status under Article 370.
India’s independence was the culmination of nearly two centuries of political change, resistance, and negotiation. This timeline revisits the milestones that shaped India’s struggle for independence, as recorded by The Hindu .
Explore an interactive timeline of Indian democracy, dissent, constitutional milestones, protests, and the Emergency through archival visuals and key historical events.
Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma on Saturday (August 15, 2026) said the State government was preparing a comprehensive rehabilitation plan for the flood-affected families .
He said the focus of such a plan would be on rebuilding infrastructure, restoring livelihoods, and creating a more flood-resilient Assam.
In his Independence Day message, the Chief Minister emphasised stronger infrastructure, reliable early-warning forecasts, and resilient livelihoods, maintaining that a rapid digital assessment of the flood damage would enable faster rehabilitation and reconstruction.
The Independence Day flag-hoisting ceremony at Kozhikode Corporation in Kerala on Saturday (August 15) witnessed unusual scenes when two groups of councillors sang the national anthem, Jana Gana Mana, and the national song, Vande Mataram, simultaneously. Chaos at Kozhikode Corporation’s I-Day flag-hoisting as councillors simultaneously sing national anthem, Vande Mataram Kozhikode's Independence Day ceremony saw chaos as councillors sang the national anthem and Vande Mataram simultaneously, causing confusion.
Kozhikode's Independence Day ceremony saw chaos as councillors sang the national anthem and Vande Mataram simultaneously, causing confusion.
Nagaland celebrated the 80th Independence Day on Saturday (August 15) with Chief Minister Neiphiu Rio calling for unity, an early and honourable solution to the long-standing Naga Political Issue, early operationalisation of the FNTA , and continued peace and stability in the State.
The state-level celebration was held at the Civil Secretariat Plaza, where Mr. Rio hoisted the National Flag, took the salute and addressed government employees and a limited gathering of the public.
Mr. Rio inspected the parade and presented awards to police personnel and civil servants for meritorious and distinguished service.
Students were not present at the official programme as the influential Naga Students’ Federation (NSF) enforced its boycott call against participation in it over the mandatory singing of the entire “Vande Mataram” song.- PTI
Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah on Saturday (August 15) extended greetings and best wishes to his Indian counterpart Narendra Modi and the people of India on the occasion of the country’s 80th Independence Day.
Mr. Shah’s message comes amid Nepal’s efforts to strengthen ties with India, with the Himalayan nation seeking greater economic cooperation and connectivity with its immediate neighbour.- PTI
Jharkhand Chief Minister Hemant Soren on Saturday (August 15) said the hard work of job aspirants would not be left at the mercy of the paper leak mafia, corruption or irregularities, and huge employment opportunities would be made available to them through the State’s recruitment agencies.
Mr. Soren’s assurance in his Independence Day speech came at a time when agitation by students demanding reforms in Jharkhand’s recruitment examination process entered its 22nd day.- PTI
Mizoram Chief Minister Lalduhoma on Saturday (August 15) said that a new system of governance remains central to the present ZPM government’s vision to build a self-reliant economy.
Addressing the Independence Day programme, Mr. Lalduhoma said achieving self-sufficiency in food and other essential sectors was a key objective of his government, alongside improving livelihoods and ensuring balanced development across Mizoram.
“We are taking steps to build a stronger system of governance and a self-reliant, more developed state, while improving the living standards of the people. To achieve self-sufficiency in food and other essential areas, our central vision has been, and will continue to be, a ‘people’s government’ with a new vision and a new approach,” he said after hoisting the Tricolour.- PTI
In the start-up years, the Institute’s annual budget was just ₹3 lakh. There were shortages galore. In fact, the teacher shortage was so dire that Jagat Murari could hardly keep the institute running. The solution? He persuaded some of the finest filmmakers to come to Pune as guest faculty. Directors such as David Lean, Satyajit Ray, Ritwik Ghatak, Raj Kapoor, Ismail Merchant, James Ivory, and many others walked through the FTII gates. Cinematographers like R.D. Mathur (of Mughal-e-Azam fame) and Subrata Mitra (Ray’s cameraman) came. Kamini Kaushal and Balraj Sahni taught acting. In the academic year 1963-64, he pulled in 50 such guest lecturers.
On India’s 80th Independence Day, the enduring legacy of Jagat Murari, FTII’s former head, asks if public institutions can still nurture independent thinkers
PDP president Mehbooba Mufti on Saturday (August 15, 2026) called on the BJP-led government at the Centre to reflect on whether India truly embodies the principles outlined in the Constitution.
“The BJP government at the Centre should think if, after 80 years, we have realised the dream of India as envisioned in the Constitution,” Ms. Mufti told reporters after attending the Independence Day function at Bakshi Stadium.
Her comments came in response to Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s request for all political parties to support the implementation of women’s reservation in Parliament and State assemblies without turning it into a political battle.- PTI
Deputy Chief Minister K. Pawan Kalyan has asked the youth to think before believing something, question before following, and inquire before taking a decision.
Addressing the youth after hoisting the national flag during the 80 th Independence Day celebrations at District Police Grounds in Kakinada city on Saturday (August 15, 2026), Mr. Kalyan has reiterated, “In the era of technology, information is reaching the people at good speed, but speed is not truth. For a strong democracy, the country needs informed citizens and not blind followers”. Country needs informed citizens, not blind followers for strong democracy, says Deputy CM K. Arunachal Pradesh Chief Minister Pema Khandu on Saturday (August 15, 2026) vowed to rebuild the State in a better way after floods ravaged the region, and announced a ₹7,834 crore investment between 2026 and 2029 to strengthen roads, rural connectivity and other key infrastructure.
Hoisting the Tricolour at Indira Gandhi Park here, on the occasion of India’s 80th Independence Day, he said the recent natural disasters had brought back to focus the need for safer and more resilient infrastructure in the frontier State.- PTI

On the morning of August 15, 2001, as Tamil Nadu Chief Minister J. Jayalalithaa hoisted the national flag at Fort St. George, about 3.5 km away, scores of journalists sat on a fast outside the M.A. Chidambaram Cricket Stadium, near the State Guest House in Chennai.
About 48 hours earlier, several journalists, particularly photographers and camerapersons, had been subjected to a savage attack by the police just outside the office of the Director General of Police on Dr. Radhakrishnan Salai.
Independence Day celebrations are under way across the country. Here are glimpses from a few States:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi called for a collective effort to make India drug-free, urging families to join the 100-day nationwide Nasha Mukt Yuva Abhiyan.
In his address to the nation on the 80th Independence Day, Modi said drug addiction has emerged as a major challenge for the country’s youth, and stressed the need to tackle it.
“Drug addiction is becoming a very big challenge for the country and its youth. Making India drug-free should be a collective responsibility of all of us,” he said from the ramparts of the Red Fort.
“For our bright future, our youth generation should be strong, our youth should be capable and should work for the country,” he said.
Mr. Modi urged volunteers, NGOs, social and cultural organisations and spiritual leaders to prepare for the 100-week campaign for a drug-free India.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi delivered a 75-minute Independence Day speech on Saturday (Augst 15, the shortest in four years and his fourth shortest ever.
On India’s 79th Independence Day last year, Modi had delivered a 103-minute speech, breaking his own record of a 98-minute address delivered on the 78th Independence Day in 2024.
His longest Independence Day speech before 2024 was for 96 minutes in 2016, while his shortest speech was in 2017, when he spoke for 56 minutes.
Maoist extremism is breathing its last in the country, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said, as he called for “identifying and isolating” the “dimagi Naxals”.
Addressing the nation on the 80th Independence Day, the Prime Minister said Naxalism and Maoism destroyed the future of several youths.
“For four decades, huge areas and people were in their clutches under the fear of guns. Over 3,500 security personnel died protecting people; the number is higher than those who die in war,” he said.
“When we came to power in 2014, we swore to rid the country of Naxals. I am happy Maoist violence is taking its last breath,” he said, adding that several areas have become free of Naxalites and are becoming developed.
Mr. Modi added, “For years, those with Naxal mentality had their place in the power corridors. They were in government committees as advisors. Maoist thinking impacted policies.
“We have succeeded in getting rid of armed Naxals in the jungles, but ‘dimagi Naxals’ are looking for opportunities to create violence, unrest … They want to drag the society on the wrong path,” he said.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced free online coaching for aspirants preparing for competitive exams to ease the financial burden on their families.
“Coaching classes burden the poor and the middle class. We will provide free online coaching for various exams,” Mr. Modi said in his address to the nation on India’s 80th Independence Day.
“Every parent feels that if they do not send their child to a coaching class, they are not a prestigious family,” he said.
The Prime Minister said he assures these families that they can save “thousands of crores of rupees” spent on coaching, be close to their children, and care for them.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi said the country added 650 new universities in the last decade and more than doubled the number of medical seats since 2014.
In his address to the nation on the 80th Independence Day, Modi said the government brought in a new education policy after decades.
“For 35 years, there was no education policy. We brought a new education policy,” he said from the ramparts of the Red Fort.
“From 2004 to 2014, there were fewer than 350 universities. And today, within 10-12 years, nearly 650 new universities have been added,” the Prime Minister said.
“Before 2014, there were only 400 medical seats, and today nearly 850 medical seats are available,” he added.
In his speech, Prime Minister Narendra Modi appealed to all parties to extend their support for Women’s reservation in Parliament and Assemblies.
“33% reservation for women is call of the hour, appeal to all parties to support and take credit for it,” he said.
The Centre, the state, and the industry must work together for reforms, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said on Saturday.
In his address to the nation from the ramparts of the Red Fort, Modi said that society, government, and industry must change their traditional ways, thinking, and targets to achieve Viksit Bharat by 2047.
“Things that have not been done in the last five or six decades, we have to do them in the next five to seven years. I have faith in my country’s youth, farmers, labourers, daughters, and mothers to be able to do this,” he said.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi highlighted the pace of railway electrification under his government, saying 70% of the network was electrified in 10 years compared with 30% in the previous 90 years.
Addressing the nation from the ramparts of the Red Fort on the occasion of the 80th Independence Day, Mr. Modi said railway electrification had begun in 1925 but only 30% of the network was electrified in the next 90 years.
“We completed 100% electrification in just one decade. Thirty per cent in 90 years and 70% in 10 years -- this is the pace of work,” he said.
He said electrification has helped save imported diesel and benefited the environment as trains are increasingly powered by electricity.
PM Modi asked MSMEs not to let go of opportunities being provided by the trade agreements being signed by the country.
“World has started recognising our abilities; we have concluded FTAs with 40 countries,” he said, adding that markets of world open for Indian farmers, we have to reach there. “Our agri-products must become global brands.”
“There should be no compromise with quality, our mantra should be ‘quality, quality, quality’.”
When West Asia crisis happened, some people tried to scare us that we will not get petrol, diesel or LPG, PM Modi says during his address, adding that his government proved naysayers wrong by ensuring sufficient energy supplies.
“Some people weaponised systems at their disposal during times of crisis, but our self-reliance helped us.”
“Due to our measures there is no shortage of gas, fuel, urea in country today,” he added.
PM Modi said India is moving forward on harnessing alternative sources of energy.
“We have set target of 200 GW nuclear energy, setting up 5 new nuclear reactors,” he said, adding that over 50 lakh households in country now covered by solar energy.
Piped gas is reaching 1.75 crore households today, he said.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi assured families affected by floods and landslides in several parts of the country that the government stands with them and shares their pain.
Addressing the nation from the ramparts of the Red Fort after hoisting the national flag on the occasion of the 80th Independence Day, Modi said, “My dear Indians, in the past few days, some parts of the country have witnessed floods and landslides, and many families have been affected. We fully understand their pain and suffering. I assure the affected families that the entire country stands with them.” He expressed solidarity with those affected by the natural calamities.
Saying that Energy security is the demand of our times, PM Modi added that his Government has taken several steps for this.
Mr. Modi also urged self-reliance, saying “We cannot remain dependent on other nations.”
“Many countries are now depending on India for critical minerals,” he said adding that India has set up semi-conductor plants in its bid to become ‘aatmanirbhar’
Addressing the nation from ramparts of Red Fort, PM Modi, says, “A nation becomes great and achieves its aspirations when it moves forward on the strength of its dreams, its resolve and its capabilities. My fellow citizens, our country can no longer be driven by small dreams. We must dream big, because big dreams expand our thinking and broaden the horizons of our vision. Our resolve must be firm. When our resolve is strong, the ability to find a way through difficulties and disasters emerges on its own.”
Nearly 5,000 special guests from different walks of life, including women entrepreneurs, young innovators, farmers and beneficiaries of various government schemes, are in attendance at the 80th Independence Day celebrations at the Red Fort.
The invitees included International Yoga Day volunteers, women entrepreneurs under the PM Mudra Yojana, beneficiaries of schemes including NAMASTE, PM AJAY and SEED, and best performing My Bharat volunteers.
Best performing beneficiaries of PMAY(U), street vendors under PM SVANidhi, urban sanitation workers under the Swachh Bharat Mission, best performing Delhi Metro workers, workers associated with Kartavya Path and Central Vista, staff of government hospitals in Delhi were also part of the gathering.
The special guests also included young innovators under national innovation programmes, scientists in different fields, cab drivers of Bharat Taxi in Delhi, interns under the Prime Minister Internship Scheme, and best performing start-ups supported under various government schemes.
During his address to the nation, PM Modi calls upon Indian citizens to realise the dream of Viksit Bharat by 2047.
Mr. Modi says that despite gaining freedom in 1947, the country couldn’t gain speed towards becoming a developed country.
PM Modi has begun his addresses to the nation from the ramparts of the Red Fort in New Delhi.
Prior to the this, for the first time, the National Song, ‘Vande Mataram’, was rendered during the Independence Day celebrations at the Red Fort.
Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge said India’s constitutional values, democratic institutions and social harmony have faced “serious challenges” over the last 10 years, as he called for full measure of equality and justice for the economically-weaker sections.
In his message to people on India’s 80th Independence Day, Mr. Kharge said the country has travelled a long way, but many aspirations still remain unfulfilled.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi greeted people on the occasion of Independence Day and said powered by 140 crore Indians, the country is scaling new heights of progress across different sectors.
Mr. Modi also paid tributes to the countless freedom fighters whose courage, sacrifice and unwavering commitment ensured the end of colonial rule.

In his 13th address to the nation — the first in 80 years that saw Vande Mataram preceding the national anthem — the Prime Minister directly spoke to some of the challenges facing India’s economy, security and domestic anxieties with regard to the youth, employment, and the advent of Artificial Intelligence (AI).

The honoured police personnel have made notable contributions in maintaining law and order and controlling crime. Among the honoured police personnel, ASI Rajendra was specially honoured for making the supreme sacrifice in the line of duty. Odisha Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi on Saturday (August 15, 2026) advised youths to focus on their career, instead of being influenced by “external forces” that do not want to see India as a strong nation, while asserting that only Prime Minister Narendra Modi can solve their problems. Addressing a State-level event here marking the 80th Independence Day, the Chief Minister made five major announcements, including removing the maximum limit of six chances for the State civil service exam. Aspirants can now appear in the exam till they reach the upper age limit. He also announced compassionate recruitment following the death of government employees, creating three lakh employment opportunities in the next two to three years, which will be extended to 20 lakh in the next five years. BJP MP Anurag Thakur on Saturday accused the Congress leadership of showing “deep discomfort” with the full rendition of Vande Mataram at the party headquarters on Independence Day and demanded that the Congress apologise to the nation, alleging that its leaders insulted the National Song. “Today, the Congress leadership has once again demonstrated its deep discomfort with the full rendition of ‘Vande Mataram’. The Congress must apologise to the entire nation,” he added. Thakur claimed that while the original version of ‘Vande Mataram’, which he alleged was earlier “discarded or removed” by former Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru, was being sung, Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge, Sonia Gandhi and Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi appeared uncomfortable. Ladakh Lieutenant Governor V K Saxena on Saturday joined the people of the Union territory in celebrating the 80th Independence Day by hoisting the national flag at the polo ground here and taking the salute of the marching contingents. Addressing the gathering, Saxena paid tribute to the freedom fighters whose courage and sacrifice secured the country’s Independence and laid the foundation for its democratic journey, an official statement said. He also saluted the armed forces, paramilitary personnel, Ladakh Scouts, police and Border Roads Organisation (BRO) staff performing their duties amid the challenging terrain and harsh climate of Ladakh. Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah on Saturday (August 15, 2026) extended greetings and best wishes to his Indian counterpart Narendra Modi and the people of India on the occasion of the country’s 80th Independence Day. The campaign symbolically traces the journey of the rising sun across time zones, carrying the spirit of India’s freedom, unity and national pride across continents, officials said. “With the first rays of the sun, the Indian flag was raised first in Suva, Fiji, marking the beginning of the global Tiranga relay, ‘Surya Path Tiranga’ - a symbolic journey carrying the spirit of India’s Independence Day across the world,” the High Commission of India in Fiji posted on X. Sikkim Governor Om Prakash Mathur on Saturday (August 15, 2026) inaugurated the first organ transplantation centre and post-transplant ICU at STNM Hospital here. Two Sikkimese patients underwent kidney transplants for the first time within the State. The Governor inaugurated the facilities in the presence of Chief Minister Prem Singh Tamang and Health Minister GT Dhungel. Speaking to reporters after the inauguration, Mr. Tamang called the commencement of kidney transplantation in Sikkim a “historic milestone”, saying it had been achieved on the state’s 80th Independence Day. Gujarat Deputy Chief Minister Harsh Sanghavi on Saturday (August 15, 2026) called for planning to achieve the ambitious goal of ‘Viksit Bharat’ by 2047, saying only two decades were left to meet the target. He was addressing a gathering after hoisting the national flag at the Manjalpur Sports Complex in Vadodara as part of the district-level Independence Day celebration. “Only 20 years remain until India completes 100 years of independence. Prime Minister Narendra Modi set the goal of Viksit Bharat at 2047 five years ago. There are now only two decades to achieve this ambitious goal. Therefore, the 80th Independence Day is not merely a celebration; it is a great source of inspiration for planning the next 20 years,” he said. Addressing the nation on the 80th Independence Day, the Prime Minister said Naxalism and Maoism destroyed the future of several youths. “For four decades, huge areas and people were in their clutches under the fear of guns. Over 3,500 security personnel died protecting people; the number is higher than those who die in war,” he said. “When we came to power in 2014, we swore to rid the country of Naxals. I am happy Maoist violence is taking its last breath,” he said, adding that several areas have become free of Naxalites and are becoming developed. Modi added, “For years, those with Naxal mentality had their place in the power corridors. They were in government committees as advisors. Maoist thinking impacted policies. “We have succeeded in getting rid of armed Naxals in the jungles, but ‘dimagi Naxals’ are looking for opportunities to create violence, unrest … They want to drag the society on the wrong path,” he said. Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced free online coaching for aspirants preparing for competitive exams to ease the financial burden on their families. “Coaching classes burden the poor and the middle class. We will provide free online coaching for various exams,” Mr. Modi said in his address to the nation on India’s 80th Independence Day. “Every parent feels that if they do not send their child to a coaching class, they are not a prestigious family,” he said. The Prime Minister said he assures these families that they can save “thousands of crores of rupees” spent on coaching, be close to their children, and care for them. Prime Minister Narendra Modi said the country added 650 new universities in the last decade and more than doubled the number of medical seats since 2014. In his address to the nation on the 80th Independence Day, Modi said the government brought in a new education policy after decades. “For 35 years, there was no education policy. We brought a new education policy,” he said from the ramparts of the Red Fort. “From 2004 to 2014, there were fewer than 350 universities. And today, within 10-12 years, nearly 650 new universities have been added,” the Prime Minister said. “Before 2014, there were only 400 medical seats, and today nearly 850 medical seats are available,” he added. In his speech, Prime Minister Narendra Modi appealed to all parties to extend their support for Women’s reservation in Parliament and Assemblies. “33% reservation for women is call of the hour, appeal to all parties to support and take credit for it,” he said. The Centre, the state, and the industry must work together for reforms, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said on Saturday. In his address to the nation from the ramparts of the Red Fort, Modi said that society, government, and industry must change their traditional ways, thinking, and targets to achieve Viksit Bharat by 2047. “Things that have not been done in the last five or six decades, we have to do them in the next five to seven years. I have faith in my country’s youth, farmers, labourers, daughters, and mothers to be able to do this,” he said. Prime Minister Narendra Modi highlighted the pace of railway electrification under his government, saying 70% of the network was electrified in 10 years compared with 30% in the previous 90 years. Addressing the nation from the ramparts of the Red Fort on the occasion of the 80th Independence Day, Mr. Modi said railway electrification had begun in 1925 but only 30% of the network was electrified in the next 90 years. “We completed 100% electrification in just one decade. Thirty per cent in 90 years and 70% in 10 years -- this is the pace of work,” he said. He said electrification has helped save imported diesel and benefited the environment as trains are increasingly powered by electricity. PM Modi asked MSMEs not to let go of opportunities being provided by the trade agreements being signed by the country. “World has started recognising our abilities; we have concluded FTAs with 40 countries,” he said, adding that markets of world open for Indian farmers, we have to reach there. “Our agri-products must become global brands.” “There should be no compromise with quality, our mantra should be ‘quality, quality, quality’.” When West Asia crisis happened, some people tried to scare us that we will not get petrol, diesel or LPG, PM Modi says during his address, adding that his government proved naysayers wrong by ensuring sufficient energy supplies. “Some people weaponised systems at their disposal during times of crisis, but our self-reliance helped us.” “Due to our measures there is no shortage of gas, fuel, urea in country today,” he added. PM Modi said India is moving forward on harnessing alternative sources of energy. “We have set target of 200 GW nuclear energy, setting up 5 new nuclear reactors,” he said, adding that over 50 lakh households in country now covered by solar energy. Piped gas is reaching 1.75 crore households today, he said. Prime Minister Narendra Modi assured families affected by floods and landslides in several parts of the country that the government stands with them and shares their pain. Addressing the nation from the ramparts of the Red Fort after hoisting the national flag on the occasion of the 80th Independence Day, Modi said, “My dear Indians, in the past few days, some parts of the country have witnessed floods and landslides, and many families have been affected. We fully understand their pain and suffering. I assure the affected families that the entire country stands with them.” He expressed solidarity with those affected by the natural calamities. Saying that Energy security is the demand of our times, PM Modi added that his Government has taken several steps for this. Modi also urged self-reliance, saying “We cannot remain dependent on other nations.” “Many countries are now depending on India for critical minerals,” he said adding that India has set up semi-conductor plants in its bid to become ‘aatmanirbhar’ Addressing the nation from ramparts of Red Fort, PM Modi, says, “A nation becomes great and achieves its aspirations when it moves forward on the strength of its dreams, its resolve and its capabilities. My fellow citizens, our country can no longer be driven by small dreams. We must dream big, because big dreams expand our thinking and broaden the horizons of our vision. Our resolve must be firm. When our resolve is strong, the ability to find a way through difficulties and disasters emerges on its own.” Nearly 5,000 special guests from different walks of life, including women entrepreneurs, young innovators, farmers and beneficiaries of various government schemes, are in attendance at the 80th Independence Day celebrations at the Red Fort. The invitees included International Yoga Day volunteers, women entrepreneurs under the PM Mudra Yojana, beneficiaries of schemes including NAMASTE, PM AJAY and SEED, and best performing My Bharat volunteers. Best performing beneficiaries of PMAY(U), street vendors under PM SVANidhi, urban sanitation workers under the Swachh Bharat Mission, best performing Delhi Metro workers, workers associated with Kartavya Path and Central Vista, staff of government hospitals in Delhi were also part of the gathering. The special guests also included young innovators under national innovation programmes, scientists in different fields, cab drivers of Bharat Taxi in Delhi, interns under the Prime Minister Internship Scheme, and best performing start-ups supported under various government schemes. During his address to the nation, PM Modi calls upon Indian citizens to realise the dream of Viksit Bharat by 2047. Modi says that despite gaining freedom in 1947, the country couldn’t gain speed towards becoming a developed country. PM Modi has begun his addresses to the nation from the ramparts of the Red Fort in New Delhi. Prior to the this, for the first time, the National Song, ‘Vande Mataram’, was rendered during the Independence Day celebrations at the Red Fort. Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge said India’s constitutional values, democratic institutions and social harmony have faced “serious challenges” over the last 10 years, as he called for full measure of equality and justice for the economically-weaker sections. In his message to people on India’s 80th Independence Day, Mr. Kharge said the country has travelled a long way, but many aspirations still remain unfulfilled. Prime Minister Narendra Modi greeted people on the occasion of Independence Day and said powered by 140 crore Indians, the country is scaling new heights of progress across different sectors. Modi also paid tributes to the countless freedom fighters whose courage, sacrifice and unwavering commitment ensured the end of colonial rule. hi.headline: 80वें स्वतंत्रता दिवस अपडेट: विश्व नेताओं ने भारत को शुभकामनाएं दीं; विपक्ष ने पीएम मोदी के 'दिमागी नक्सली' तंज की आलोचना की
hi.simplified_text:
15 अगस्त, 2026 को स्वतंत्रता दिवस समारोह के दौरान खुशी बिखेरते हुए, एक छोटा बच्चा तिरंगे को ऊंचा करके मुंबई में दौड़ता है। इमैनुअल योगिनी प्रधान मंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी का शनिवार (15 अगस्त, 2026) को लाल किले की प्राचीर से स्वतंत्रता दिवस का संबोधन "सप्तधारा" नामक सात सूत्री सुधार योजना और एआई कौशल और मुफ्त ऑनलाइन कोचिंग के माध्यम से युवाओं तक पहुंच, चिंताओं का जवाब देने के प्रयास से भरा हुआ था। वैश्वीकरण के बाद की अर्थव्यवस्था से संबंधित। राष्ट्र के नाम अपने 13वें संबोधन में - 80 वर्षों में पहला संबोधन जिसमें राष्ट्रगान से पहले वंदे मातरम शामिल हुआ - प्रधान मंत्री ने युवाओं, रोजगार और आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस (एआई) के आगमन के संबंध में भारत की अर्थव्यवस्था, सुरक्षा और घरेलू चिंताओं के सामने आने वाली कुछ चुनौतियों पर सीधे बात की।

केरल के मुख्यमंत्री वी.डी. सतीसन ने शनिवार (15 अगस्त, 2026) को तिरुवनंतपुरम के सेंट्रल स्टेडियम में स्वतंत्रता दिवस समारोह के दौरान लोगों से "खुले दिमाग, सहिष्णुता, बहस, आत्म-सुधार और नवाचार पर स्थापित एक मजबूत लोकतंत्र के संरक्षक और सेनानी" बनने का आह्वान किया। बाढ़ पीड़ितों को याद करते हुए, असम के मुख्यमंत्री हिमंत बिस्वा सरमा ने शनिवार (15 अगस्त, 2026) को कहा कि राज्य सरकार बाढ़ प्रभावित परिवारों के लिए एक व्यापक पुनर्वास योजना तैयार कर रही है। यह स्वतंत्रता दिवस, शायद एक नागरिक के रूप में हमारे लिए सबसे महत्वपूर्ण अनुस्मारक यह है कि लोकतंत्र का पुनर्निर्माण और रखरखाव बातचीत और बातचीत के माध्यम से किया जाता है। जब लोग पार करते हैं

ta.headline: 80வது சுதந்திர தின அறிவிப்புகள்: உலகத் தலைவர்கள் இந்தியாவுக்கு வாழ்த்துக்களைத் தெரிவிக்கின்றனர்; பிரதமர் மோடியின் 'திமாகி நக்சல்' ஜிபியை எதிர்க்கட்சிகள் கடுமையாக சாடியுள்ளன
ta.simplified_text:
ஆகஸ்ட் 15, 2026 அன்று சுதந்திர தின கொண்டாட்டத்தின் போது ஒரு இளம் குழந்தை மும்பையில் மூவர்ணக் கொடியுடன் வேகமாக ஓடுகிறது. இம்மானுவல் யோகினி பிரதமர் நரேந்திர மோடி சனிக்கிழமை (ஆகஸ்ட் 15, 2026) செங்கோட்டையின் அரண்மனையிலிருந்து ஆற்றிய சுதந்திர தின உரையில் ஏழு அம்ச சீர்திருத்தத் திட்டம் மற்றும் இளைஞர்களின் மறுசீரமைப்புத் திட்டம் நிரம்பியது. உலகமயமாக்கலுக்குப் பிந்தைய பொருளாதாரம் தொடர்பான கவலைகளுக்கு பதிலளிக்கும் முயற்சியில் இலவச ஆன்லைன் பயிற்சி. தேசத்திற்கு அவர் ஆற்றிய 13வது உரையில் - 80 ஆண்டுகளில் தேசிய கீதத்திற்கு முன் வந்தே மாதரம் பாடலைப் பார்த்தது - இளைஞர்கள், வேலைவாய்ப்பு மற்றும் செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவின் (AI) வருகை தொடர்பாக இந்தியாவின் பொருளாதாரம், பாதுகாப்பு மற்றும் உள்நாட்டு கவலைகள் எதிர்கொள்ளும் சில சவால்கள் குறித்து பிரதமர் நேரடியாக பேசினார்.

கேரள முதல்வர் வி.டி. சதீசன், சனிக்கிழமை (ஆகஸ்ட் 15, 2026) திருவனந்தபுரத்தில் உள்ள சென்ட்ரல் ஸ்டேடியத்தில் நடைபெற்ற சுதந்திர தினக் கொண்டாட்டத்தின் போது, ​​"திறந்த மனப்பான்மை, சகிப்புத்தன்மை, விவாதம், சுய திருத்தம் மற்றும் புதுமை ஆகியவற்றின் அடிப்படையில் வலுவான ஜனநாயகத்தின் பாதுகாவலர்களாகவும் போராளிகளாகவும் மாற வேண்டும்" என்று மக்களுக்கு அழைப்பு விடுத்தார். வெள்ளத்தால் பாதிக்கப்பட்டவர்களை நினைவு கூர்ந்த அசாம் முதல்வர் ஹிமந்தா பிஸ்வா சர்மா சனிக்கிழமை (ஆகஸ்ட் 15, 2026) வெள்ளத்தால் பாதிக்கப்பட்ட குடும்பங்களுக்கு விரிவான மறுவாழ்வுத் திட்டத்தை மாநில அரசு தயாரித்து வருவதாகக் கூறினார். இந்த சுதந்திர தினம், ஒருவேளை குடிமக்களாகிய நமக்கு மிக முக்கியமான நினைவூட்டல், உரையாடல் மற்றும் ஊடாடுதல் மூலம் ஜனநாயகம் மீண்டும் கட்டமைக்கப்பட்டு நிலைத்திருக்கிறது. மக்கள் குறுக்கே செல்லும் போது

mr.headline: 80 व्या स्वातंत्र्यदिनाचे अपडेट: जागतिक नेत्यांनी भारताला दिल्या शुभेच्छा; विरोधकांनी पंतप्रधान मोदींच्या 'दिमागी नक्षल' ची टीका केली
mr.simplified_text:
१५ ऑगस्ट २०२६ रोजी झालेल्या स्वातंत्र्यदिनाच्या समारंभात तिरंगा उंच फडकवत मुंबईतून एक लहान मूल धावत होते. इमान्युअल योगिनी पंतप्रधान नरेंद्र मोदी यांचे शनिवारी (१५ ऑगस्ट २०२६) लाल किल्ल्याच्या तटबंदीवरून स्वातंत्र्यदिनी संबोधित करण्यात आले होते आणि “सात-पॉइंट प्लॅन” नावाच्या “सात-पॉइंट” या योजनेला पूर्ण केले होते. जागतिकीकरणानंतरच्या अर्थव्यवस्थेशी संबंधित चिंतांना उत्तर देण्याचा प्रयत्न म्हणून एआय कौशल्य आणि मोफत ऑनलाइन कोचिंगद्वारे युवक. राष्ट्रगीतापूर्वी वंदे मातरम् हे 80 वर्षांतील पहिले भाषण - पंतप्रधानांनी देशाला दिलेल्या 13 व्या संबोधनात भारताची अर्थव्यवस्था, सुरक्षा आणि देशांतर्गत चिंता या तरुणाई, रोजगार आणि कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (AI) च्या आगमनासमोरील काही आव्हानांवर थेट भाष्य केले.

केरळचे मुख्यमंत्री व्ही.डी. शनिवारी (15 ऑगस्ट, 2026) तिरुवनंतपुरममधील सेंट्रल स्टेडियममध्ये स्वातंत्र्य दिनाच्या समारंभात सतीसन यांनी लोकांना “खुल्या विचारसरणी, सहिष्णुता, वादविवाद, आत्म-सुधारणा आणि नवोपक्रमावर स्थापन केलेल्या मजबूत लोकशाहीचे संरक्षक आणि लढवय्ये” बनण्याचे आवाहन केले. पूरग्रस्तांचे स्मरण करून, आसामचे मुख्यमंत्री हिमंता बिस्वा सरमा यांनी शनिवारी (15 ऑगस्ट, 2026) सांगितले की राज्य सरकार पूरग्रस्त कुटुंबांसाठी सर्वसमावेशक पुनर्वसन योजना तयार करत आहे. हा स्वातंत्र्यदिन, कदाचित नागरिक म्हणून आपल्यासाठी सर्वात महत्त्वाचा स्मरणपत्र आहे की संवाद आणि परस्परसंवादातून लोकशाहीची पुनर्बांधणी केली जाते आणि ती टिकून राहते. जेव्हा लोक एक्रोस

bn.headline: 80তম স্বাধীনতা দিবসের আপডেট: বিশ্ব নেতারা ভারতকে শুভেচ্ছা জানিয়েছেন; বিরোধীরা প্রধানমন্ত্রী মোদীর 'ডিমাগি নকশাল' জিবে নিন্দা করেছেন
bn.simplified_text:
15 অগাস্ট, 2026-এ স্বাধীনতা দিবস উদযাপনের সময় একটি ছোট শিশু মুম্বইয়ের মধ্য দিয়ে ত্রিবর্ণের উচ্চতায় ছুটছে, আনন্দ বিকিরণ করছে। শনিবার (15 আগস্ট, 2026) লাল কেল্লার প্রাচীর থেকে ইমানুয়াল যোগিনী প্রধানমন্ত্রী নরেন্দ্র মোদীর স্বাধীনতা দিবসের ভাষণটি "সাতটি-পয়েন্ট পরিকল্পনা" নামক একটি পুনরুদ্ধার করা হয়েছিল। বিশ্বায়ন-পরবর্তী অর্থনীতির উদ্বেগের উত্তর দেওয়ার প্রয়াসে AI দক্ষতা এবং বিনামূল্যে অনলাইন কোচিংয়ের মাধ্যমে তরুণরা। জাতির উদ্দেশ্যে তার 13 তম ভাষণে - 80 বছরের মধ্যে প্রথম যেটি জাতীয় সংগীতের আগে বন্দে মাতরম দেখেছিল - প্রধানমন্ত্রী যুব, কর্মসংস্থান এবং কৃত্রিম বুদ্ধিমত্তা (AI) এর আবির্ভাবের বিষয়ে ভারতের অর্থনীতি, নিরাপত্তা এবং গার্হস্থ্য উদ্বেগের মুখোমুখি কিছু চ্যালেঞ্জের সাথে সরাসরি কথা বলেছেন।

কেরালার মুখ্যমন্ত্রী ভি.ডি. শনিবার (15 আগস্ট, 2026) তিরুবনন্তপুরমের কেন্দ্রীয় স্টেডিয়ামে স্বাধীনতা দিবস উদযাপনের সময় সতীসান, জনগণকে "মুক্তমনা, সহনশীলতা, বিতর্ক, আত্ম-সংশোধন এবং উদ্ভাবনের উপর প্রতিষ্ঠিত একটি শক্তিশালী গণতন্ত্রের অভিভাবক এবং যোদ্ধা" হওয়ার আহ্বান জানান। বন্যায় ক্ষতিগ্রস্তদের স্মরণ করে, আসামের মুখ্যমন্ত্রী হিমন্ত বিশ্ব শর্মা শনিবার (15 আগস্ট, 2026) বলেছেন যে রাজ্য সরকার বন্যায় ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত পরিবারগুলির জন্য একটি ব্যাপক পুনর্বাসন পরিকল্পনা তৈরি করছে। এই স্বাধীনতা দিবস, সম্ভবত নাগরিক হিসাবে আমাদের জন্য সবচেয়ে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ অনুস্মারক হল যে গণতন্ত্র পুনর্গঠিত হয় এবং সংলাপ এবং মিথস্ক্রিয়া দ্বারা টেকসই হয়। যখন মানুষ জুড়ে

te.headline: 80వ స్వాతంత్ర్య దినోత్సవ నవీకరణలు: ప్రపంచ నాయకులు భారతదేశానికి శుభాకాంక్షలు తెలిపారు; ప్రధాని మోదీ ‘దిమాగీ నక్సల్‌’పై విపక్షాలు విమర్శలు గుప్పించాయి
te.simplified_text:
ఆగస్ట్ 15, 2026న జరిగిన స్వాతంత్ర్య దినోత్సవ వేడుకల సందర్భంగా త్రివర్ణ పతాకాన్ని పట్టుకుని ముంబై గుండా పరుగెత్తుతున్న చిన్న పిల్లవాడు ఆనందాన్ని వెదజల్లుతున్నాడు. శనివారం (ఆగస్టు 15, 2026) ఎర్రకోట ప్రాకారాల నుండి ఇమ్మాన్యువల్ యోగిని ప్రధాన మంత్రి నరేంద్ర మోదీ స్వాతంత్ర్య దినోత్సవ ప్రసంగం "ఏడు పాయింట్ల సంస్కరణల ప్రణాళిక" మరియు యువతకు మెరుగులు దిద్దే నైపుణ్యంతో నిండి ఉంది. ప్రపంచీకరణ అనంతర ఆర్థిక వ్యవస్థకు సంబంధించిన ఆందోళనలకు సమాధానం ఇచ్చే ప్రయత్నంలో ఉచిత ఆన్‌లైన్ కోచింగ్. దేశాన్ని ఉద్దేశించి చేసిన 13వ ప్రసంగంలో - వందేమాతరం జాతీయగీతానికి ముందు 80 సంవత్సరాలలో మొదటిసారి - యువత, ఉపాధి మరియు ఆర్టిఫిషియల్ ఇంటెలిజెన్స్ (AI) ఆవిర్భావానికి సంబంధించి భారతదేశ ఆర్థిక వ్యవస్థ, భద్రత మరియు దేశీయ ఆందోళనలు ఎదుర్కొంటున్న కొన్ని సవాళ్లపై ప్రధాని నేరుగా మాట్లాడారు.

కేరళ ముఖ్యమంత్రి వి.డి. శనివారం (ఆగస్టు 15, 2026) తిరువనంతపురంలోని సెంట్రల్ స్టేడియంలో జరిగిన స్వాతంత్య్ర దినోత్సవ వేడుకల సందర్భంగా సతీశన్, “ఓపెన్ మైండెడ్‌నెస్, టాలరెన్స్, డిబేట్, స్వీయ-దిద్దుబాటు మరియు ఆవిష్కరణలపై స్థాపించబడిన బలమైన ప్రజాస్వామ్యానికి సంరక్షకులు మరియు యోధులుగా మారాలని” ప్రజలకు పిలుపునిచ్చారు. వరద బాధితులను స్మరించుకుంటూ అస్సాం ముఖ్యమంత్రి హిమంత బిస్వా శర్మ శనివారం (ఆగస్టు 15, 2026) వరద బాధిత కుటుంబాల కోసం రాష్ట్ర ప్రభుత్వం సమగ్ర పునరావాస ప్రణాళికను సిద్ధం చేస్తోందని తెలిపారు. ఈ స్వాతంత్ర్య దినోత్సవం, బహుశా పౌరులుగా మనకు అత్యంత ముఖ్యమైన రిమైండర్ ఏమిటంటే, ప్రజాస్వామ్యం చర్చలు మరియు పరస్పర చర్యల ద్వారా పునర్నిర్మించబడి మరియు స్థిరంగా ఉంటుంది. ప్రజలు అడ్డంగా ఉన్నప్పుడు

kn.headline: 80 ನೇ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ದಿನದ ನವೀಕರಣಗಳು: ವಿಶ್ವ ನಾಯಕರು ಭಾರತಕ್ಕೆ ಶುಭಾಶಯಗಳನ್ನು ಸಲ್ಲಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಪ್ರತಿಪಕ್ಷಗಳು ಪ್ರಧಾನಿ ಮೋದಿಯವರ 'ದಿಮಗಿ ನಕ್ಸಲ್' ಜಿಬೆಯನ್ನು ಟೀಕಿಸುತ್ತವೆ
kn.simplified_text:
ಆಗಸ್ಟ್ 15, 2026 ರಂದು ನಡೆದ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ದಿನಾಚರಣೆಯ ಸಂದರ್ಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಮಗುವೊಂದು ತ್ರಿವರ್ಣ ಧ್ವಜವನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿದು ಮುಂಬೈ ಮೂಲಕ ಓಡುತ್ತಿದೆ. ಶನಿವಾರ (ಆಗಸ್ಟ್ 15, 2026) ಎಮ್ಯಾನುಯಲ್ ಯೋಗಿನಿ ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ನರೇಂದ್ರ ಮೋದಿ ಅವರ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ದಿನಾಚರಣೆಯ ಭಾಷಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಂಪು ಕೋಟೆಯ ಕೋಟೆಯಿಂದ ಮಾಡಿದ ಏಳು ಅಂಶಗಳ ಸುಧಾರಣಾ ಯೋಜನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಯುವಕರ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿಯ ಕೌಶಲ್ಯದಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿತ್ತು. ಜಾಗತೀಕರಣದ ನಂತರದ ಆರ್ಥಿಕತೆಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಆತಂಕಗಳಿಗೆ ಉತ್ತರಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನದಲ್ಲಿ ಉಚಿತ ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ತರಬೇತಿ. ದೇಶವನ್ನುದ್ದೇಶಿಸಿ ಮಾಡಿದ 13ನೇ ಭಾಷಣದಲ್ಲಿ - 80 ವರ್ಷಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊದಲ ಬಾರಿಗೆ ವಂದೇ ಮಾತರಂ ಅನ್ನು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರಗೀತೆಗೆ ಮೊದಲು ನೋಡಲಾಯಿತು - ಯುವಜನತೆ, ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ಮತ್ತು ಕೃತಕ ಬುದ್ಧಿಮತ್ತೆಯ (AI) ಆಗಮನಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದಂತೆ ಭಾರತದ ಆರ್ಥಿಕತೆ, ಭದ್ರತೆ ಮತ್ತು ದೇಶೀಯ ಆತಂಕಗಳು ಎದುರಿಸುತ್ತಿರುವ ಕೆಲವು ಸವಾಲುಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಪ್ರಧಾನಿ ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಮಾತನಾಡಿದರು.

ಕೇರಳ ಮುಖ್ಯಮಂತ್ರಿ ವಿ.ಡಿ. ಸತೀಶನ್ ಅವರು ಶನಿವಾರ (ಆಗಸ್ಟ್ 15, 2026) ತಿರುವನಂತಪುರದ ಸೆಂಟ್ರಲ್ ಸ್ಟೇಡಿಯಂನಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆದ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ದಿನಾಚರಣೆಯ ಸಂದರ್ಭದಲ್ಲಿ, "ಮುಕ್ತ ಮನಸ್ಸು, ಸಹಿಷ್ಣುತೆ, ಚರ್ಚೆ, ಸ್ವಯಂ-ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿ ಮತ್ತು ನಾವೀನ್ಯತೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಲಾದ ಪ್ರಬಲ ಪ್ರಜಾಪ್ರಭುತ್ವದ ರಕ್ಷಕರು ಮತ್ತು ಹೋರಾಟಗಾರರಾಗಲು" ಜನರಿಗೆ ಕರೆ ನೀಡಿದರು. ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಸಂತ್ರಸ್ತರನ್ನು ಸ್ಮರಿಸುತ್ತಾ, ಅಸ್ಸಾಂ ಮುಖ್ಯಮಂತ್ರಿ ಹಿಮಂತ ಬಿಸ್ವಾ ಶರ್ಮಾ ಅವರು ಶನಿವಾರ (ಆಗಸ್ಟ್ 15, 2026) ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರವು ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಪೀಡಿತ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಮಗ್ರ ಪುನರ್ವಸತಿ ಯೋಜನೆಯನ್ನು ಸಿದ್ಧಪಡಿಸುತ್ತಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿದರು. ಈ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ದಿನ, ಬಹುಶಃ ನಾಗರಿಕರಾದ ನಮಗೆ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಮುಖ್ಯವಾದ ಜ್ಞಾಪನೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಪ್ರಜಾಪ್ರಭುತ್ವವನ್ನು ಸಂವಾದ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂವಾದದ ಮೂಲಕ ಪುನರ್ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಉಳಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಜನರು ಅಡ್ಡಾದಾಗ

ml.headline: 80-ാം സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യദിന അപ്‌ഡേറ്റുകൾ: ലോക നേതാക്കൾ ഇന്ത്യക്ക് ആശംസകൾ നേർന്നു; പ്രധാനമന്ത്രി മോദിയുടെ 'ദിമാഗി നക്‌സൽ' പരിഹാസത്തെ വിമർശിച്ച് പ്രതിപക്ഷം
ml.simplified_text:
2026 ആഗസ്ത് 15 ലെ സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യ ദിനാഘോഷ വേളയിൽ ത്രിവർണ്ണ പതാക ഉയർത്തി മുംബൈയിലൂടെ ഒരു കൊച്ചുകുട്ടി കുതിക്കുന്നു. ഇമ്മാനുവൽ യോഗിനി പ്രധാനമന്ത്രി നരേന്ദ്ര മോദി ശനിയാഴ്ച (ഓഗസ്റ്റ് 15, 2026) ചെങ്കോട്ടയുടെ കൊത്തളത്തിൽ നിന്ന് സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യദിന പ്രസംഗം നടത്തിയപ്പോൾ ഏഴ് പോയിൻ്റുകളുള്ള നവീകരണ നൈപുണ്യവും യുവജനങ്ങളുടെ നവീകരണ നൈപുണ്യവും നിറഞ്ഞതായിരുന്നു. ആഗോളവൽക്കരണാനന്തര സമ്പദ്‌വ്യവസ്ഥയുമായി ബന്ധപ്പെട്ട ഉത്കണ്ഠകൾക്ക് ഉത്തരം നൽകാനുള്ള ശ്രമത്തിൽ സൗജന്യ ഓൺലൈൻ കോച്ചിംഗ്. രാജ്യത്തെ അഭിസംബോധന ചെയ്ത 13-ാമത്തെ പ്രസംഗത്തിൽ - 80 വർഷത്തിനിടെ ദേശീയ ഗാനത്തിന് മുമ്പുള്ള വന്ദേമാതരം കണ്ടത് - യുവാക്കൾ, തൊഴിൽ, ആർട്ടിഫിഷ്യൽ ഇൻ്റലിജൻസിൻ്റെ (എഐ) വരവ് എന്നിവയുമായി ബന്ധപ്പെട്ട് ഇന്ത്യയുടെ സമ്പദ്‌വ്യവസ്ഥ, സുരക്ഷ, ആഭ്യന്തര ഉത്കണ്ഠകൾ എന്നിവ നേരിടുന്ന ചില വെല്ലുവിളികളെക്കുറിച്ച് പ്രധാനമന്ത്രി നേരിട്ട് സംസാരിച്ചു.

കേരള മുഖ്യമന്ത്രി വി.ഡി. ശനിയാഴ്ച (ഓഗസ്റ്റ് 15, 2026) തിരുവനന്തപുരത്തെ സെൻട്രൽ സ്റ്റേഡിയത്തിൽ നടന്ന സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യദിനാഘോഷത്തിൽ സതീശൻ, “തുറന്ന മനസ്സിലും സഹിഷ്ണുതയിലും സംവാദത്തിലും സ്വയം തിരുത്തലിലും നവീകരണത്തിലും അധിഷ്ഠിതമായ ശക്തമായ ജനാധിപത്യത്തിൻ്റെ സംരക്ഷകരും പോരാളികളും ആകാൻ” ആളുകളെ ആഹ്വാനം ചെയ്തു. പ്രളയബാധിതരെ അനുസ്മരിച്ചുകൊണ്ട് അസം മുഖ്യമന്ത്രി ഹിമന്ത ബിശ്വ ശർമ്മ ശനിയാഴ്ച (ഓഗസ്റ്റ് 15, 2026) പ്രളയബാധിത കുടുംബങ്ങൾക്കായി സംസ്ഥാന സർക്കാർ സമഗ്രമായ പുനരധിവാസ പദ്ധതി തയ്യാറാക്കുകയാണെന്ന് പറഞ്ഞു. ഈ സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യ ദിനം, ഒരുപക്ഷേ, പൗരന്മാർ എന്ന നിലയിൽ നമുക്കുള്ള ഏറ്റവും പ്രധാനപ്പെട്ട ഓർമ്മപ്പെടുത്തൽ, ജനാധിപത്യം പുനർനിർമ്മിക്കുകയും നിലനിർത്തുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നത് സംഭാഷണത്തിലൂടെയും ആശയവിനിമയത്തിലൂടെയുമാണ്. ആളുകൾ കൂടുമ്പോൾ

original.headline: SCoR Vijayawada division records ₹4,894 crore revenue in first four months: DRM
original.raw_text:
Taking part in the Independence Day celebrations, Mohit Sonakiya says freight loading touched 32.084 million tonnes, generating around ₹3,343 crore revenue South Coast Railway (SCoR) Vijayawada  Divisional Railway Manager Mohit Sonakiya taking part in the 80th Independence Day celebrations in Vijayawada on Saturday.
                                          | Photo Credit: BY ARRANGEMENT
The Vijayawada division of South Coast Railway (SCoR), which was created recently with Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Guntur and Guntakal divisions, has recorded Gross Originating Revenue of about ₹4,894 crore during the first four months, said Divisional Railway Manager (DRM) Mohit Sonakiya.
During the Independence Day celebrations, the DRM read out the message sent by SCoR General Manager (GM) here on Saturday. Mr. Mohit Sonakiya said the freight loading touched 32.084 million tonnes, generating around ₹3,343 crore revenue.
Revenue earned on passenger fares was about ₹1,356 crore, and the passenger traffic was around 58.61 million, the DRM said, adding that 76 special trains were operated and 408 additional coaches were attached to the meet the increased passenger demand.
Earlier, Mr. Mohit Sonakiya, hoisted the national flag and received the guard of honour. He participated in the 80th Independence Day celebrations, along with Additional DRMs Konda Srinivasa Rao and P.E. Edwin, and other senior railway officicals of various department. They paid tributes to the freedom fighters, who sacrificed their lives to gain independence.
Later, the DRM presented medals and meritorious certificates to 18 students of Jack and Jill, Kendriya Vidyalaya (KV), Icon Public School, and Bharat Scouts and Guides, who excelled in essay writing, painting competitions on the topics ‘Vande Mataram’ and ‘Freedom Struggle’ conducted as part of ‘Har Ghar Tiranga’ campaign.
Family members of railway officials and staff participated in the celebrations.
Andhra Pradesh / railway / Independence Day / Vijayawada

hi.headline: एससीओआर विजयवाड़ा डिवीजन ने पहले चार महीनों में ₹4,894 करोड़ का राजस्व दर्ज किया: डीआरएम
hi.simplified_text:
स्वतंत्रता दिवस समारोह में भाग लेते हुए, मोहित सोनकिया ने कहा कि माल ढुलाई 32.084 मिलियन टन तक पहुंच गई, जिससे लगभग ₹3,343 करोड़ का राजस्व प्राप्त हुआ। दक्षिण तट रेलवे (एससीओआर) विजयवाड़ा मंडल रेल प्रबंधक मोहित सोनाकिया शनिवार को विजयवाड़ा में 80वें स्वतंत्रता दिवस समारोह में भाग ले रहे हैं। डिविजनल रेलवे मैनेजर (डीआरएम) मोहित सोनाकिया ने कहा कि साउथ कोस्ट रेलवे (एससीओआर) का विजयवाड़ा डिवीजन, जिसे हाल ही में विशाखापत्तनम, विजयवाड़ा, गुंटूर और गुंटकल डिवीजनों के साथ बनाया गया था, ने पहले चार महीनों के दौरान लगभग ₹4,894 करोड़ का सकल मूल राजस्व दर्ज किया है। स्वतंत्रता दिवस समारोह के दौरान, डीआरएम ने शनिवार को एससीओआर महाप्रबंधक (जीएम) द्वारा भेजे गए संदेश को पढ़ा।

मोहित सोनाकिया ने कहा कि माल ढुलाई 32.084 मिलियन टन तक पहुंच गई, जिससे लगभग 3,343 करोड़ रुपये का राजस्व प्राप्त हुआ। डीआरएम ने कहा कि यात्री किराये से अर्जित राजस्व लगभग ₹1,356 करोड़ था और यात्री यातायात लगभग 58.61 मिलियन था, उन्होंने कहा कि 76 विशेष ट्रेनें संचालित की गईं और बढ़ी हुई यात्री मांग को पूरा करने के लिए 408 अतिरिक्त कोच जोड़े गए। इससे पहले, श्री मोहित सोनकिया ने राष्ट्रीय ध्वज फहराया और गार्ड ऑफ ऑनर प्राप्त किया।

उन्होंने अतिरिक्त डीआरएम कोंडा श्रीनिवास राव और पी.ई. के साथ 80वें स्वतंत्रता दिवस समारोह में भाग लिया। एडविन, और विभिन्न विभाग के अन्य वरिष्ठ रेलवे अधिकारी। उन्होंने उन स्वतंत्रता सेनानियों को श्रद्धांजलि अर्पित की, जिन्होंने आजादी पाने के लिए अपने प्राणों की आहुति दी। बाद में डीआरएम ने मेडल और मेडल प्रदान किये

ta.headline: SCoR விஜயவாடா பிரிவு முதல் நான்கு மாதங்களில் ₹4,894 கோடி வருவாய்: டிஆர்எம்
ta.simplified_text:
சுதந்திர தின விழாவில் பங்கேற்ற மோஹித் சோனகியா கூறுகையில், சரக்கு ஏற்றுதல் 32.084 மில்லியன் டன்னை தொட்டுள்ளது, இதன் மூலம் சுமார் ₹3,343 கோடி வருவாய் கிடைத்துள்ளது. சவுத் கோஸ்ட் ரயில்வே (எஸ்சிஓஆர்) விஜயவாடா  டிவிஷனல் ரயில்வே மேலாளர் மோஹித் சோனகியா விஜயவாடாவில் சனிக்கிழமை 80வது சுதந்திர தின விழாவில் பங்கேற்றார். விசாகப்பட்டினம், விஜயவாடா, குண்டூர் மற்றும் குண்டக்கல் கோட்டங்களுடன் சமீபத்தில் உருவாக்கப்பட்ட தென் கடற்கரை ரயில்வேயின் விஜயவாடா கோட்டம், முதல் நான்கு மாதங்களில் சுமார் ₹4,894 கோடி மொத்த வருவாய் ஈட்டியுள்ளது என்று கோட்ட ரயில்வே மேலாளர் (டிஆர்எம்) மோஹித் சோனகியா தெரிவித்தார். சுதந்திர தின கொண்டாட்டத்தின் போது, ​​SCoR பொது மேலாளர் (GM) அனுப்பிய செய்தியை DRM சனிக்கிழமை இங்கு வாசித்தார்.

சரக்கு ஏற்றுதல் 32.084 மில்லியன் டன்களைத் தொட்டதாகவும், இதன் மூலம் சுமார் ₹3,343 கோடி வருவாயைப் பெற்றதாகவும் மோஹித் சோனகியா கூறினார். பயணிகளின் கட்டணத்தில் ஈட்டிய வருவாய் சுமார் ₹1,356 கோடி, மற்றும் பயணிகள் போக்குவரத்து சுமார் 58.61 மில்லியன், அதிகரித்த பயணிகளின் தேவையை பூர்த்தி செய்ய 76 சிறப்பு ரயில்கள் இயக்கப்பட்டு 408 கூடுதல் பெட்டிகள் இணைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளன என்று DRM கூறினார். முன்னதாக, திரு.மோஹித் சோனகியா, தேசியக் கொடியை ஏற்றி வைத்து மரியாதையை பெற்றார்.

அவர் 80வது சுதந்திர தின விழாவில் பங்கேற்றார், கூடுதல் டிஆர்எம்கள் கொண்டா சீனிவாச ராவ் மற்றும் பி.இ. எட்வின் மற்றும் பல்வேறு துறைகளின் மூத்த ரயில்வே அதிகாரிகள். சுதந்திரத்திற்காக உயிர் தியாகம் செய்த சுதந்திர போராட்ட வீரர்களுக்கு அஞ்சலி செலுத்தினர். பின்னர், டிஆர்எம் பதக்கங்கள் மற்றும் மெரி வழங்கினார்

mr.headline: SCoR विजयवाडा विभागात पहिल्या चार महिन्यांत ₹ 4,894 कोटी महसूल नोंदवला: DRM
mr.simplified_text:
स्वातंत्र्य दिनाच्या समारंभात भाग घेऊन, मोहित सोनाकिया म्हणाले की मालवाहतूक 32.084 दशलक्ष टनांवर पोहोचली आहे, ज्यामुळे सुमारे ₹3,343 कोटी उत्पन्न झाले आहे दक्षिण किनारी रेल्वे (SCoR) विजयवाडा विभागीय रेल्वे व्यवस्थापक मोहित सोनकिया यांनी 80 तारखेच्या अखेरीस विजा दिवसाच्या उत्सवात भाग घेतला. शनिवार. नुकत्याच विशाखापट्टणम, विजयवाडा, गुंटूर आणि गुंटकल विभागांसह तयार करण्यात आलेल्या दक्षिण कोस्ट रेल्वेच्या (SCoR) विजयवाडा विभागाने पहिल्या चार महिन्यांत सुमारे ₹4,894 कोटींचा एकूण उत्पन्न नोंदवला आहे, असे विभागीय रेल्वे व्यवस्थापक (DRM) मोहित सोनाकिया यांनी सांगितले. स्वातंत्र्य दिनाच्या उत्सवादरम्यान, DRM ने शनिवारी येथे SCoR महाव्यवस्थापक (GM) यांनी पाठवलेला संदेश वाचून दाखवला.

मोहित सोनाकिया म्हणाले की मालवाहतूक 32.084 दशलक्ष टनांपर्यंत पोहोचली, ज्यामुळे सुमारे ₹3,343 कोटी महसूल जमा झाला. प्रवासी भाड्यांवरील महसूल सुमारे ₹1,356 कोटी होता आणि प्रवासी वाहतूक सुमारे 58.61 दशलक्ष होती, DRM म्हणाले की, वाढीव प्रवाशांच्या मागणीसाठी 76 विशेष गाड्या चालवण्यात आल्या आणि 408 अतिरिक्त डबे जोडण्यात आले. तत्पूर्वी, श्री. मोहित सोनकिया यांनी राष्ट्रध्वज फडकावला आणि गार्ड ऑफ ऑनर स्वीकारला.

अतिरिक्त DRM कोंडा श्रीनिवास राव आणि P.E. यांच्यासह त्यांनी 80 व्या स्वातंत्र्यदिनाच्या सोहळ्यात भाग घेतला. एडविन आणि विविध विभागाचे इतर वरिष्ठ रेल्वे अधिकारी. त्यांनी स्वातंत्र्यसैनिकांना श्रद्धांजली वाहिली, ज्यांनी स्वातंत्र्य मिळवण्यासाठी आपल्या प्राणांची आहुती दिली. नंतर, डीआरएमने पदक आणि मेरी प्रदान केली

bn.headline: SCOR বিজয়ওয়াড়া বিভাগ প্রথম চার মাসে ₹ 4,894 কোটি রাজস্ব রেকর্ড করেছে: DRM
bn.simplified_text:
স্বাধীনতা দিবস উদযাপনে অংশ নিয়ে মোহিত সোনাকিয়া বলেছেন যে মালবাহী লোডিং 32.084 মিলিয়ন টন ছুঁয়েছে, যা প্রায় ₹3,343 কোটি রাজস্ব উৎপন্ন করেছে দক্ষিণ উপকূল রেলওয়ে (SCoR) বিজয়ওয়াড়া ডিভিশনাল রেলওয়ে ম্যানেজার মোহিত সোনাকিয়া 2010-এর শেষের দিকে সিবিএডেতে অংশ নিয়েছিলেন শনিবার। দক্ষিণ উপকূল রেলওয়ের বিজয়ওয়াদা বিভাগ (SCoR), যা সম্প্রতি বিশাখাপত্তনম, বিজয়ওয়াড়া, গুন্টুর এবং গুন্টকাল বিভাগগুলির সাথে তৈরি করা হয়েছিল, প্রথম চার মাসে প্রায় ₹4,894 কোটির মোট মূল রাজস্ব রেকর্ড করেছে, ডিভিশনাল রেলওয়ে ম্যানেজার (ডিআরএম) মোহিত সোনাকিয়া বলেছেন। স্বাধীনতা দিবস উদযাপনের সময়, ডিআরএম শনিবার এখানে এসসিওআর জেনারেল ম্যানেজার (জিএম) এর পাঠানো বার্তাটি পড়ে শোনান।

মোহিত সোনাকিয়া বলেন, মালবাহী লোডিং 32.084 মিলিয়ন টন ছুঁয়েছে, যা প্রায় ₹3,343 কোটি রাজস্ব তৈরি করেছে। যাত্রী ভাড়ার রাজস্ব ছিল প্রায় ₹1,356 কোটি, এবং যাত্রী ট্র্যাফিক ছিল প্রায় 58.61 মিলিয়ন, DRM বলেছেন, 76টি বিশেষ ট্রেন পরিচালনা করা হয়েছে এবং 408টি অতিরিক্ত কোচ যুক্ত করা হয়েছে যাত্রীর চাহিদা মেটাতে। এর আগে, জনাব মোহিত সোনাকিয়া, জাতীয় পতাকা উত্তোলন এবং গার্ড অব অনার গ্রহণ করেন।

তিনি অতিরিক্ত ডিআরএম কোন্ডা শ্রীনিবাস রাও এবং পিই এর সাথে 80 তম স্বাধীনতা দিবস উদযাপনে অংশ নিয়েছিলেন। এডউইনসহ রেলওয়ের বিভিন্ন বিভাগের ঊর্ধ্বতন কর্মকর্তারা। তারা স্বাধীনতা অর্জনের জন্য জীবন উৎসর্গকারী মুক্তিযোদ্ধাদের প্রতি শ্রদ্ধা জানান। পরে ডিআরএম পদক ও মেরি প্রদান করেন

te.headline: SCoR విజయవాడ డివిజన్ మొదటి నాలుగు నెలల్లో ₹4,894 కోట్ల ఆదాయాన్ని నమోదు చేసింది: DRM
te.simplified_text:
స్వాతంత్య్ర దినోత్సవ వేడుకల్లో పాల్గొన్న మోహిత్ సోనాకియా మాట్లాడుతూ, సరుకు రవాణా 32.084 మిలియన్ టన్నులకు చేరుకుందని, దీని ద్వారా దాదాపు ₹3,343 కోట్ల ఆదాయం సమకూరిందని సౌత్ కోస్ట్ రైల్వే (SCoR) విజయవాడ  డివిజనల్ రైల్వే మేనేజర్ మోహిత్ సోనకియా శనివారం విజయవాడలో 80వ స్వాతంత్ర్య దినోత్సవ వేడుకల్లో పాల్గొన్నారు. విశాఖపట్నం, విజయవాడ, గుంటూరు మరియు గుంతకల్ డివిజన్లతో ఇటీవల ఏర్పడిన సౌత్ కోస్ట్ రైల్వే (SCoR) విజయవాడ డివిజన్ మొదటి నాలుగు నెలల్లో సుమారు ₹4,894 కోట్ల స్థూల ఆదాయాన్ని నమోదు చేసిందని డివిజనల్ రైల్వే మేనేజర్ (DRM) మోహిత్ సోనకియా తెలిపారు. స్వాతంత్ర్య దినోత్సవ వేడుకల సందర్భంగా, శనివారం ఇక్కడ SCoR జనరల్ మేనేజర్ (GM) పంపిన సందేశాన్ని DRM చదివి వినిపించారు.

సరుకు రవాణా 32.084 మిలియన్ టన్నులకు చేరుకుందని, దాదాపు ₹3,343 కోట్ల ఆదాయాన్ని ఆర్జించిందని మోహిత్ సోనాకియా తెలిపారు. ప్రయాణీకుల ఛార్జీలపై ఆదాయం సుమారు ₹1,356 కోట్లు, ప్రయాణికుల రద్దీ దాదాపు 58.61 మిలియన్లు, పెరిగిన ప్రయాణీకుల డిమాండ్‌కు అనుగుణంగా 76 ప్రత్యేక రైళ్లు నడపబడ్డాయి మరియు 408 అదనపు కోచ్‌లను జోడించినట్లు DRM తెలిపారు. ముందుగా శ్రీ మోహిత్ సోనాకియా జాతీయ జెండాను ఎగురవేసి గౌరవ వందనం స్వీకరించారు.

80వ స్వాతంత్య్ర దినోత్సవ వేడుకల్లో అదనపు డీఆర్‌ఎంలు కొండా శ్రీనివాసరావు, పీఈలతో కలిసి ఆయన పాల్గొన్నారు. ఎడ్విన్ మరియు వివిధ శాఖలకు చెందిన ఇతర సీనియర్ రైల్వే అధికారులు. స్వాతంత్య్ర సమరయోధులను త్యాగం చేసి స్వాతంత్య్ర సమరయోధులకు నివాళులర్పించారు. అనంతరం డీఆర్‌ఎం మెడల్స్‌, మెరిపించారు

kn.headline: SCoR ವಿಜಯವಾಡ ವಿಭಾಗವು ಮೊದಲ ನಾಲ್ಕು ತಿಂಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ₹ 4,894 ಕೋಟಿ ಆದಾಯವನ್ನು ದಾಖಲಿಸಿದೆ: DRM
kn.simplified_text:
ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ದಿನಾಚರಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾಗವಹಿಸಿದ ಮೋಹಿತ್ ಸೋನಕಿಯಾ ಅವರು, ಸರಕು ಸಾಗಣೆಯು 32.084 ಮಿಲಿಯನ್ ಟನ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಮುಟ್ಟಿದ್ದು, ಸುಮಾರು ₹3,343 ಕೋಟಿ ಆದಾಯವನ್ನು ಗಳಿಸಿದೆ ಎಂದು ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಕರಾವಳಿ ರೈಲ್ವೆ (ಎಸ್‌ಸಿಒಆರ್) ವಿಜಯವಾಡ  ವಿಭಾಗೀಯ ರೈಲ್ವೆ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಾಪಕ ಮೋಹಿತ್ ಸೋನಕಿಯಾ ವಿಜಯವಾಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಶನಿವಾರ ನಡೆದ 80ನೇ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ದಿನಾಚರಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾಗವಹಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ವಿಶಾಖಪಟ್ಟಣಂ, ವಿಜಯವಾಡ, ಗುಂಟೂರು ಮತ್ತು ಗುಂತಕಲ್ ವಿಭಾಗಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಇತ್ತೀಚೆಗೆ ರಚಿಸಲಾದ ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಕರಾವಳಿ ರೈಲ್ವೆಯ (ಎಸ್‌ಸಿಒಆರ್) ವಿಜಯವಾಡ ವಿಭಾಗವು ಮೊದಲ ನಾಲ್ಕು ತಿಂಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಮಾರು ₹ 4,894 ಕೋಟಿ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೂಲ ಆದಾಯವನ್ನು ದಾಖಲಿಸಿದೆ ಎಂದು ವಿಭಾಗೀಯ ರೈಲ್ವೆ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಾಪಕ (ಡಿಆರ್‌ಎಂ) ಮೋಹಿತ್ ಸೋನಕಿಯಾ ಹೇಳಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ದಿನಾಚರಣೆಯ ಸಂದರ್ಭದಲ್ಲಿ, ಶನಿವಾರ ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಎಸ್‌ಸಿಒಆರ್ ಜನರಲ್ ಮ್ಯಾನೇಜರ್ (ಜಿಎಂ) ಕಳುಹಿಸಿದ ಸಂದೇಶವನ್ನು ಡಿಆರ್‌ಎಂ ಓದಿದರು.

ಸರಕು ಸಾಗಣೆಯು 32.084 ಮಿಲಿಯನ್ ಟನ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಮುಟ್ಟಿದೆ, ಸುಮಾರು ₹ 3,343 ಕೋಟಿ ಆದಾಯವನ್ನು ಗಳಿಸಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಮೋಹಿತ್ ಸೋನಕಿಯಾ ಹೇಳಿದರು. ಪ್ರಯಾಣಿಕ ದರದಲ್ಲಿ ಗಳಿಸಿದ ಆದಾಯ ಸುಮಾರು ₹ 1,356 ಕೋಟಿ, ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಯಾಣಿಕರ ದಟ್ಟಣೆ ಸುಮಾರು 58.61 ಮಿಲಿಯನ್ ಆಗಿತ್ತು, ಹೆಚ್ಚಿದ ಪ್ರಯಾಣಿಕರ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಪೂರೈಸಲು 76 ವಿಶೇಷ ರೈಲುಗಳನ್ನು ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ ಮತ್ತು 408 ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಬೋಗಿಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ ಎಂದು DRM ಹೇಳಿದರು. ಇದಕ್ಕೂ ಮುನ್ನ ಮೋಹಿತ್ ಸೋನಕಿಯಾ ಅವರು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರ ಧ್ವಜಾರೋಹಣ ನೆರವೇರಿಸಿ ಗೌರವ ವಂದನೆ ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಿದರು.

80ನೇ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ದಿನಾಚರಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾಗವಹಿಸಿದ ಅವರು, ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಡಿಆರ್‌ಎಂಗಳಾದ ಕೊಂಡ ಶ್ರೀನಿವಾಸ ರಾವ್ ಮತ್ತು ಪಿ.ಇ. ಎಡ್ವಿನ್ ಮತ್ತು ವಿವಿಧ ಇಲಾಖೆಯ ಹಿರಿಯ ರೈಲ್ವೆ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿಗಳು. ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಪ್ರಾಣ ತ್ಯಾಗ ಮಾಡಿದ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟಗಾರರಿಗೆ ಶ್ರದ್ಧಾಂಜಲಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದರು. ನಂತರ, ಡಿಆರ್‌ಎಂ ಪದಕ ಮತ್ತು ಮೇರಿ ಪ್ರದಾನ ಮಾಡಿದರು

ml.headline: SCoR വിജയവാഡ ഡിവിഷൻ ആദ്യ നാല് മാസത്തിനുള്ളിൽ 4,894 കോടി രൂപയുടെ വരുമാനം രേഖപ്പെടുത്തി: DRM
ml.simplified_text:
സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യദിനാഘോഷത്തിൽ പങ്കെടുത്ത് മോഹിത് സോനകിയ പറഞ്ഞു, ചരക്ക് ലോഡിംഗ് 32.084 ദശലക്ഷം ടണ്ണിൽ എത്തി, ഏകദേശം ₹3,343 കോടി വരുമാനം സൗത്ത് കോസ്റ്റ് റെയിൽവേ (എസ്‌സിഒആർ) വിജയവാഡ  ഡിവിഷണൽ റെയിൽവേ മാനേജർ മോഹിത് സോനകിയ വിജയവാഡയിൽ ശനിയാഴ്ച നടന്ന 80-ാം സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യദിനാഘോഷത്തിൽ പങ്കെടുത്തു. വിശാഖപട്ടണം, വിജയവാഡ, ഗുണ്ടൂർ, ഗുണ്ടക്കൽ ഡിവിഷനുകൾക്കൊപ്പം അടുത്തിടെ രൂപീകൃതമായ സൗത്ത് കോസ്റ്റ് റെയിൽവേയുടെ (എസ്‌സിഒആർ) വിജയവാഡ ഡിവിഷൻ ആദ്യ നാല് മാസങ്ങളിൽ ഏകദേശം 4,894 കോടി രൂപയുടെ മൊത്ത വരുമാനം രേഖപ്പെടുത്തിയതായി ഡിവിഷണൽ റെയിൽവേ മാനേജർ (ഡിആർഎം) മോഹിത് സോനകിയ പറഞ്ഞു. സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യദിനാഘോഷ വേളയിൽ, ശനിയാഴ്ച ഇവിടെ എസ്‌സിഒആർ ജനറൽ മാനേജർ (ജിഎം) അയച്ച സന്ദേശം ഡിആർഎം വായിച്ചു.

ചരക്ക് ലോഡിംഗ് 32.084 ദശലക്ഷം ടണ്ണിൽ എത്തി, ഏകദേശം 3,343 കോടി രൂപ വരുമാനം ഉണ്ടാക്കിയതായി മോഹിത് സോനകിയ പറഞ്ഞു. യാത്രാക്കൂലിയിൽ നിന്ന് ലഭിച്ച വരുമാനം ഏകദേശം 1,356 കോടി രൂപയും യാത്രക്കാരുടെ എണ്ണം 58.61 ദശലക്ഷവുമാണ്, വർദ്ധിച്ച യാത്രക്കാരുടെ ആവശ്യം നിറവേറ്റുന്നതിനായി 76 പ്രത്യേക ട്രെയിനുകൾ ഓടിക്കുകയും 408 അധിക കോച്ചുകൾ ഘടിപ്പിച്ചതായും ഡിആർഎം പറഞ്ഞു. നേരത്തെ, മോഹിത് സോനകിയ ദേശീയ പതാക ഉയർത്തുകയും ഗാർഡ് ഓഫ് ഓണർ സ്വീകരിക്കുകയും ചെയ്തു.

80-ാം സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യദിനാഘോഷത്തിൽ അദ്ദേഹം പങ്കെടുത്തു, അഡീഷണൽ ഡിആർഎംമാരായ കൊണ്ട ശ്രീനിവാസ റാവു, പി.ഇ. എഡ്വിൻ, വിവിധ വകുപ്പുകളിലെ മുതിർന്ന റെയിൽവേ ഉദ്യോഗസ്ഥർ എന്നിവർ പങ്കെടുത്തു. സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യം നേടുന്നതിനായി ജീവൻ ബലിയർപ്പിച്ച സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യ സമര സേനാനികൾക്ക് അവർ ആദരാഞ്ജലികൾ അർപ്പിച്ചു. പിന്നീട് ഡിആർഎം മെഡലുകളും മെറിയും സമ്മാനിച്ചു

original.headline: Leading countries extend greetings to India on 80th Independence Day
original.raw_text:
French President Emmanuel Macron, Russian President Vladimir Putin, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese and Maldivian President Mohamed Muizzu were among leaders who hailed ties with India on the occasion Visitors throng the Kartavya Path overlooking the illuminated Rashtrapati Bhavan on the occasion of the 80th Independence Day, in New Delhi, Saturday, Aug. 15, 2026. File
                                          | Photo Credit: PTI
India’s global partners, including France, Russia and Australia, on Saturday (August 15, 2026) extended greetings to the country on its 80 th Independence Day, reaffirming their commitment to strengthening bilateral ties and regional cooperation.
French President Emmanuel Macron, Russian President Vladimir Putin, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese and Maldivian President Mohamed Muizzu were among leaders who hailed ties with India on the occasion.
Mr. Macron took to X to extend his greetings. “Congratulations to the Indian people on your 80th Independence Day!” he said.
Mr. Putin extended greetings to President Droupadi Murmu as well as Prime Minister Narendra Modi, expressing confidence that the constructive bilateral partnership will help enhance international security and stability.
The Russian President said Russia-India relations are developing successfully in the spirit of a “particularly privileged strategic partnership”.
He pointed out that Moscow and New Delhi are engaged in “fruitful cooperation” across a wide range of areas and coordinate closely within the framework of the United Nations, the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO), BRICS, and other multilateral institutions.
“I am confident that, through our joint efforts, we will continue to comprehensively strengthen the constructive Russia-India partnership for the benefit of our friendly peoples and in the interests of enhancing international security and stability,” the Russian President said.
Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese also conveyed his greetings on the occasion, asserting that India has gone “from strength to strength” in the eight decades since its independence.
In a statement, Mr. Albanese said that India, as the world’s largest democracy and fastest-growing major economy, “fills us with awe at the scale of its achievements and the vastness of its potential”.
He recalled his Mr. Modi’s recent visit to Australia, where he told the Prime Minister, “Our relationship has never been more consequential”.
“We are excited to further deepen Australia and India’s engagement in new and growing areas with the support of the many Australians of Indian heritage who are the living bridge in our valued friendship. I join you in celebrating India’s history and culture, rich diversity and extraordinary achievements - and in celebrating the promise our shared future holds,” he said.
In his greeting, Maldivian leader Mr. Muizzu reiterated the archipelago’s commitment to enhance bilateral ties with India. “Eight decades of Independence reflect the aspirations, resilience and enduring spirit of the Government and people of India.
“On this auspicious occasion, I reaffirm the commitment of the Government of Maldives to further advance our close partnership built upon mutual respect, shared prosperity and enduring friendship between our two peoples,” he said on X.
Israeli President Isaac Herzog also wished India’s top leadership and the “wonderful people” of the country on Independence Day. “May we continue to strengthen the beautiful friendship between Israel and India,” he said in a social media post.
In a letter to President Murmu, her Singaporean counterpart Tharman Shanmugaratnam congratulated her and the people of India on the occasion, asserting that both countries share an “enduring interest in a peaceful, open, and connected region”.
The city-state will continue working closely with India, as one of ASEAN’s oldest Dialogue Partners, to strengthen regional integration and resilience, especially in trade, the digital economy, energy security, and the energy transition, he said.
Calling the Singapore-India ties “multifaceted”, he said the two nations also share a robust and forward-looking Comprehensive Strategic Partnership underpinned by close people-to-people ties.
“By drawing on our complementary strengths, I am confident that our two countries will continue to identify fresh opportunities for the benefit of our peoples,” he said.
On the occasion, Nepal Prime Minister Balendra ‘Balen’ Shah extended “heartfelt greetings” to Prime Minister Modi and the “friendly people” of India.
“May the deep historical ties, close people-to-people relations and cooperation between Nepal and India continue to strengthen in the years ahead,” Mr. Shah said, according to a social media post by his office.
Bhutan’s Prime Minister Tshering Tobgay also wished the government and people of India on Independence Day.
In a social media post, he said, “To my elder brother PM Narendra Modi and the people of India, I extend my warm wishes on the 80th Independence Day.” “May the enduring friendship and close ties between Bhutan and India continue to flourish.”
In his message, former Maldivian President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih called India’s journey since 1947 an “inspiration to developing countries”. “India’s journey since 1947 has been an inspiration to developing countries such as the Maldives on our own path to democracy. May the close ties of cooperation and friendship that exist between Maldives–India grow ever stronger,” he said on X.
Earlier on Friday, U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio also extended his greetings and asserted that the bilateral ties were stronger than ever due to the personal relationship between President Donald Trump and Mr. Modi.
In a statement, Mr. Rubio said the deep ties of friendship and family between the people of the two countries form the foundation of a partnership that is innovative, resilient and forward-looking.
“On behalf of the United States of America, I extend warm congratulations to the people of India on their Independence Day,” Mr. Rubio said, adding that bilateral collaboration is making both nations, and the broader Indian Ocean region, safer, stronger, and more prosperous.

articles.simplified_headline: Leading countries extend greetings to India on 80th Independence Day
articles.simplified_text: Leaders from around the world extended greetings to India on its 80th Independence Day, reaffirming their commitment to strengthening bilateral ties and regional cooperation. They expressed confidence in the potential of the India-Russia partnership to enhance international security and stability. hi.headline: प्रमुख देशों ने भारत को 80वें स्वतंत्रता दिवस की शुभकामनाएं दीं
hi.simplified_text:
फ्रांस के राष्ट्रपति इमैनुएल मैक्रॉन, रूसी राष्ट्रपति व्लादिमीर पुतिन, ऑस्ट्रेलियाई प्रधान मंत्री एंथनी अल्बनीस और मालदीव के राष्ट्रपति मोहम्मद मुइज्जू उन नेताओं में शामिल थे, जिन्होंने इस अवसर पर भारत के साथ संबंधों की सराहना की, नई दिल्ली में 80वें स्वतंत्रता दिवस के अवसर पर रोशनी से जगमगाते राष्ट्रपति भवन के सामने कार्तव्य पथ पर पर्यटक उमड़ पड़े। फ़ाइल फ्रांस, रूस और ऑस्ट्रेलिया सहित भारत के वैश्विक साझेदारों ने शनिवार (15 अगस्त, 2026) को देश को शुभकामनाएं दीं। अपने 80वें स्वतंत्रता दिवस पर, द्विपक्षीय संबंधों और क्षेत्रीय सहयोग को मजबूत करने की अपनी प्रतिबद्धता की पुष्टि की। इस अवसर पर फ्रांस के राष्ट्रपति इमैनुएल मैक्रॉन, रूसी राष्ट्रपति व्लादिमीर पुतिन, ऑस्ट्रेलियाई प्रधान मंत्री एंथनी अल्बनीस और मालदीव के राष्ट्रपति मोहम्मद मुइज्जू उन नेताओं में शामिल थे जिन्होंने भारत के साथ संबंधों की सराहना की।

मैक्रॉन अपना अभिवादन बढ़ाने के लिए एक्स के पास गए। "भारत के लोगों को 80वें स्वतंत्रता दिवस की बधाई!" उसने कहा। पुतिन ने राष्ट्रपति द्रौपदी मुर्मू के साथ-साथ प्रधान मंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी को भी शुभकामनाएं दीं और विश्वास जताया कि रचनात्मक द्विपक्षीय साझेदारी अंतरराष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा और स्थिरता को बढ़ाने में मदद करेगी। रूसी राष्ट्रपति ने कहा कि रूस-भारत संबंध "विशेष विशेषाधिकार प्राप्त रणनीतिक साझेदारी" की भावना से सफलतापूर्वक विकसित हो रहे हैं।

उन्होंने बताया कि मॉस्को और नई दिल्ली व्यापक क्षेत्रों में "सार्थक सहयोग" में लगे हुए हैं और संयुक्त राष्ट्र, शा के ढांचे के भीतर निकटता से समन्वय कर रहे हैं।

ta.headline: இந்தியாவின் 80வது சுதந்திர தினத்தை முன்னிட்டு முன்னணி நாடுகள் வாழ்த்துக்களை தெரிவித்து வருகின்றன
ta.simplified_text:
பிரான்ஸ் அதிபர் இம்மானுவேல் மேக்ரான், ரஷ்ய அதிபர் விளாடிமிர் புடின், ஆஸ்திரேலிய பிரதமர் அந்தோணி அல்பனீஸ், மாலத்தீவு அதிபர் முகமது முய்சு உள்ளிட்ட தலைவர்கள் இந்தியாவுடனான உறவைப் பாராட்டினர். பிரான்ஸ், ரஷ்யா மற்றும் ஆஸ்திரேலியா, சனிக்கிழமை (ஆகஸ்ட் 15, 2026) நாட்டிற்கு அதன் 80 வது சுதந்திர தின வாழ்த்துக்களை தெரிவித்தன, இருதரப்பு உறவுகள் மற்றும் பிராந்திய ஒத்துழைப்பை வலுப்படுத்துவதற்கான தங்கள் உறுதிப்பாட்டை மீண்டும் உறுதிப்படுத்துகின்றன. பிரான்ஸ் அதிபர் இம்மானுவேல் மேக்ரான், ரஷ்ய அதிபர் விளாடிமிர் புதின், ஆஸ்திரேலிய பிரதமர் அந்தோணி அல்பானீஸ், மாலத்தீவு அதிபர் முகமது முய்சு உள்ளிட்ட தலைவர்கள் இந்தியாவுடனான உறவை பாராட்டினர்.

மக்ரோன் தனது வாழ்த்துக்களை X க்கு அனுப்பினார். "உங்கள் 80வது சுதந்திர தினத்தில் இந்திய மக்களுக்கு வாழ்த்துக்கள்!" அவர் கூறினார். ஜனாதிபதி திரௌபதி முர்மு மற்றும் பிரதமர் நரேந்திர மோடி ஆகியோருக்கு புடின் வாழ்த்து தெரிவித்தார், ஆக்கபூர்வமான இருதரப்பு கூட்டாண்மை சர்வதேச பாதுகாப்பு மற்றும் ஸ்திரத்தன்மையை மேம்படுத்த உதவும் என்று நம்பிக்கை தெரிவித்தார். ரஷ்யா-இந்தியா உறவுகள் "குறிப்பாக சலுகை பெற்ற மூலோபாய கூட்டாண்மை" என்ற உணர்வில் வெற்றிகரமாக வளர்ந்து வருவதாக ரஷ்ய ஜனாதிபதி கூறினார்.

மாஸ்கோவும் புது தில்லியும் பரந்த அளவிலான பகுதிகளில் "பயனுள்ள ஒத்துழைப்பில்" ஈடுபட்டுள்ளன என்றும் ஐக்கிய நாடுகள் சபையின் கட்டமைப்பிற்குள் நெருக்கமாக ஒருங்கிணைக்கின்றன என்றும் அவர் சுட்டிக்காட்டினார்.

mr.headline: प्रमुख देशांनी भारताला 80 व्या स्वातंत्र्य दिनाच्या शुभेच्छा दिल्या आहेत
mr.simplified_text:
फ्रान्सचे राष्ट्राध्यक्ष इमॅन्युएल मॅक्रॉन, रशियाचे राष्ट्राध्यक्ष व्लादिमीर पुतिन, ऑस्ट्रेलियाचे पंतप्रधान अँथनी अल्बानीज आणि मालदीवचे राष्ट्राध्यक्ष मोहम्मद मुइझू हे 80 व्या स्वातंत्र्यदिनाच्या निमित्ताने भारतासोबतच्या संबंधांचे कौतुक करणाऱ्या नेत्यांपैकी एक होते. फ्रान्स, रशिया आणि ऑस्ट्रेलियाने शनिवारी (15 ऑगस्ट, 2026) देशाला 80 व्या स्वातंत्र्य दिनानिमित्त शुभेच्छा दिल्या आणि द्विपक्षीय संबंध आणि प्रादेशिक सहकार्य मजबूत करण्याच्या त्यांच्या वचनबद्धतेची पुष्टी केली. फ्रान्सचे राष्ट्राध्यक्ष इमॅन्युएल मॅक्रॉन, रशियाचे अध्यक्ष व्लादिमीर पुतिन, ऑस्ट्रेलियाचे पंतप्रधान अँथनी अल्बानीज आणि मालदीवचे राष्ट्राध्यक्ष मोहम्मद मुइझ्झू यांनी भारतासोबतच्या संबंधांची प्रशंसा केली.

मॅक्रॉन यांनी X ला शुभेच्छा दिल्या. “तुमच्या 80 व्या स्वातंत्र्य दिनानिमित्त भारतीय जनतेला शुभेच्छा!” तो म्हणाला. पुतिन यांनी राष्ट्रपती द्रौपदी मुर्मू तसेच पंतप्रधान नरेंद्र मोदी यांना शुभेच्छा दिल्या आणि विधायक द्विपक्षीय भागीदारी आंतरराष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा आणि स्थिरता वाढविण्यात मदत करेल असा विश्वास व्यक्त केला. रशियाचे अध्यक्ष म्हणाले की, रशिया-भारत संबंध “विशेषत: विशेषाधिकारप्राप्त धोरणात्मक भागीदारी” च्या भावनेने यशस्वीपणे विकसित होत आहेत.

त्यांनी निदर्शनास आणून दिले की मॉस्को आणि नवी दिल्ली विविध क्षेत्रांमध्ये “फलदायी सहकार्य” करत आहेत आणि संयुक्त राष्ट्रांच्या चौकटीत जवळून समन्वय साधतात.

bn.headline: নেতৃস্থানীয় দেশগুলি 80 তম স্বাধীনতা দিবসে ভারতকে শুভেচ্ছা জানায়৷
bn.simplified_text:
ফরাসি রাষ্ট্রপতি ইমানুয়েল ম্যাক্রোঁ, রাশিয়ার রাষ্ট্রপতি ভ্লাদিমির পুতিন, অস্ট্রেলিয়ার প্রধানমন্ত্রী অ্যান্থনি আলবানিজ এবং মালদ্বীপের রাষ্ট্রপতি মোহামেদ মুইজ্জু ছিলেন এমন নেতাদের মধ্যে যারা ভারতের সাথে সম্পর্ককে স্বাগত জানিয়েছেন এই অনুষ্ঠানে দর্শনার্থীরা 80 তম স্বাধীনতা দিবস উপলক্ষে আলোকিত রাষ্ট্রপতি ভবনকে উপেক্ষা করে কার্তব্য পথে ভিড় করেছিলেন, শনিবার ভারতে, বিশ্বব্যাপী স্বাধীনতা দিবস, এ ফি অংশীদার। ফ্রান্স, রাশিয়া এবং অস্ট্রেলিয়া, শনিবার (15 আগস্ট, 2026) দেশটিকে তার 80 তম স্বাধীনতা দিবসে শুভেচ্ছা জানিয়েছে, দ্বিপাক্ষিক সম্পর্ক এবং আঞ্চলিক সহযোগিতা জোরদার করার প্রতিশ্রুতি পুনর্ব্যক্ত করেছে। ফরাসি রাষ্ট্রপতি ইমানুয়েল ম্যাক্রোঁ, রাশিয়ার রাষ্ট্রপতি ভ্লাদিমির পুতিন, অস্ট্রেলিয়ার প্রধানমন্ত্রী অ্যান্থনি আলবানিজ এবং মালদ্বীপের রাষ্ট্রপতি মোহাম্মদ মুইজু এই অনুষ্ঠানে ভারতের সাথে সম্পর্ককে স্বাগত জানিয়েছিলেন।

ম্যাক্রোঁ তার অভিবাদন প্রসারিত করার জন্য এক্সকে নিয়েছিলেন। "আপনার 80 তম স্বাধীনতা দিবসে ভারতীয় জনগণকে অভিনন্দন!" তিনি বলেন পুতিন রাষ্ট্রপতি দ্রৌপদী মুর্মু এবং প্রধানমন্ত্রী নরেন্দ্র মোদিকে শুভেচ্ছা জানিয়েছেন, আত্মবিশ্বাস ব্যক্ত করেছেন যে গঠনমূলক দ্বিপাক্ষিক অংশীদারিত্ব আন্তর্জাতিক নিরাপত্তা ও স্থিতিশীলতা বাড়াতে সাহায্য করবে। রাশিয়ান রাষ্ট্রপতি বলেছিলেন যে রাশিয়া-ভারত সম্পর্ক "বিশেষ করে বিশেষ সুবিধাপ্রাপ্ত কৌশলগত অংশীদারিত্ব" এর চেতনায় সফলভাবে বিকাশ করছে।
